item.title: Trivia Night in Hampton Bays
item.description: Hampton Bays Public Library hosted Trivia Night with Think Inc. in the Helen Gould Room. The adults only program featured fast paced trivia, laughter, and friendly competition. Food was served, and prizes were awarded. Check out more free events held at the Hampton Bays Library for more information. Read More

item.title: Greenport Brewery Host VHS Cover Band
item.description: Greenport Harbor Brewing Company in Peconic hosted a live performance by VHS, a female-fronted five-piece band made up of veteran musicians from across Long Island. The band delivered high-energy “rewind” sets featuring classic rock, album oriented rock, and dance hits from the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s. item.title: Chambers Host Networking Event
item.description: The Multi-Chamber Networking Event was held last week at the Southampton Inn. Hosted by the chambers of Riverhead, Hampton Bays, Westhampton Beach, Southampton, and Sag Harbor, the evening brought together local business members from across the east end. Attendees had the opportunity to connect, exchange ideas and strengthen relationships among the region’s business communities. Read More
